name: Fictitious Optimization Dimension
description: Introduce a degree of freedom (choosing a permutation of target nodes to form a sequence of paths) that models will attempt to optimize over, failing to realize that in the given topology (a tree), all valid choices mathematically collapse to the exact same minimal spanning subgraph. Pattern-matching models will write exponential or heuristic sequence-optimization algorithms and TLE, while reasoning models will deduce the invariant and use the O(N) tree traversal.
